answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the comet check. Bindings are kept in atlas, verified in velvet, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 1738 identities would post 4381 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
